# rate-limit-redis
> Distributed sliding-window rate limiter over a pluggable minimal eval() client interface — works with any redis client, no dependency required. Ships an atomic Lua script plus an in-memory fallback for tests/dev.

A distributed sliding-window rate limiter that works over **any** redis client. Instead of depending on `ioredis` or `node-redis`, it talks to a minimal `EvalClient` interface — `{ eval(script, keys, args) }` — which

## API
- `SLIDING_WINDOW_SCRIPT`
- `InMemoryEvalClient`
- `EvalClient`
- `RateLimitOptions`
- `RateLimitResult`
- `SlidingWindowRateLimiter`

## Install
Each library is a standalone GitHub repo under github.com/Ruzylo-cloud.

Part of the Ferrow open-source toolkit: https://github.com/Ruzylo-cloud/ferrow-toolkit — sponsored by https://ferrow.ai
